name: Zhejiang Great Southeast Corp.Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Great Southeast Corp.Ltd operates within China's plastic packaging industry. The company's primary offerings include a diverse range of plastic films such as multi-functional cast polypropylene (CPP), polyethylene terephthalate (PET), biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP), and polyethylene (PE), largely employed for food packaging purposes. Beyond these core products, they manufacture specialized films for various applications, including those for lithium batteries, capacitors, and thermal transfer, in addition to materials for chemical and medical packaging. Their product scope also extends to military-grade films and horticultural films. Furthermore, Zhejiang Great Southeast produces EVA encapsulation films essential for solar photovoltaic cells. Notably, the company also invests in research and development for a 3D game engine platform, intended to facilitate the creation of online games. In an ongoing commitment to innovation, the firm is actively developing advanced materials such as military VCI anti-corrosion films, lithium-ion battery separators, optical films, light conversion films, BOPP synthetic papers, and novel high-temperature resistant electronic insulation materials. Established in 1975, Zhejiang Great Southeast Corp.Ltd is based in Zhuji, China.
